items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I remember Mama Rainey. Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. I know about her. I got her records too. Yeah, sir. See, I keep all that, you know, because I figure that's going a hundred years from now, people will still be looking for records by Bessie Smith and Blind Lemon. Yeah, sir. So we'll keep all that. Yeah, what other records do you remember? And what other people are at this time?
I'm trying to say something now. I remember Mama Rainey. Oh, yeah.
I like her. Did you ever see her?
